newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-RODA BEAT WILLEM II TO REACH DUTCH CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RODA BEAT WILLEM II TO REACH DUTCH CUP FINAL.

text.p: Roda JC Kerkrade reached the Dutch Cup final on Wednesday when Gerald Sibon scored the only goal in their semifinal against Willem II Tilburg.
Roda also reached the final in 1976, 1988 and 1992 but have never won the Cup.
Sibon sealed an exciting match in which either Roda, seventh in the league, or 14th-placed Willem II could have claimed victory.
The winner came in the 77th minute when Sibon, who on Thursday is to have talks with Ajax about a move to the Amsterdam team, headed home a cross by defender Ramon van Haaren from close range.
In the final on May 8 in Rotterdam, Roda will meet Heerenveen or second division side Helmond Sport, who play their semifinal on Thursday.
